policy: References informed proportions, appendage layout and colour placement only. No pixels were sampled, traced, copied or redistributed. Seller imagery was not used as a texture or tracing source. Body depth, head depth at the eye, snout length and fin heights for fable-v2 were measured as ratios of standard length from the two Commons files listed below and then rounded to the catalog's station table.

referenceGradeRationale: Two openly licensed lateral references (an 1866 scientific lithograph with fins spread and a 2014 in-situ photograph) give consistent standard-length ratios for body depth, head depth, eye position and snout length; no calibrated top or front reference is available, so lateral width follows the Zebrasoma compressed-disc norm (depth to width about 3.8). The user-supplied watermarked seller image was used only to understand silhouette preference; not a texture source.
